title: Measurement plan and eliminating N+1
goal: Compare two explicit queries with one batch selection using the same keys and75 total.
prerequisites: onec.p6; P1–P3; explicit contracts, types, collections and failure handling.
sections: A100-request loop reading customer and rate can cause many individual calls. A shortCustomer.Descriptionexpression does not prove negligible cost. Map data sources and count calls. One form may tolerate this; bulk reporting may benefit from a combined selection. Measurements decide.
Count calls to Execute in our own code: two per-reference queries versus one IN(&Keys). This is a local measured boundary, not a count of internal SQL statements, packets or cache reads.

Record version, volume, dataset, cold/warm state and measured operation. Network, cache andUIaffect timing. Do not compare one cold baseline with a warmed new version. A small training infobase demonstrates method, not field p95 or industrial scaling.

Both paths use the same two references. One sums30+45; the other returns2/75. Check equivalence before timing. A professional larger comparison should also reconcile the complete key set and values by key.

Replace per-item reads with a query selecting required fields and correct relationships. Compare identities, rows, missing values, sums and required order. Losing request-free customers can make a report faster but wrong. Keep a small oracle dataset beside the benchmark so optimization does not change the task.

Record platform wall-clock milliseconds without claiming monotonic time. Zero and an occasionally slower batch are legitimate for this tiny dataset; no assertion requires it to be faster every run. The explicit2→1 reduction is separate from observed duration.

Report equivalence separately from call count and timing. Repeated runs reveal variability; one run is not p95. Unmeasured speedup remains a hypothesis. Do not enlargeNexusstartup budgets for the course; NEXUS-PERF-01checks those independently.

Use a new copy for a larger synthetic dataset, consistent conditions and at least five runs per variant. Retain raw timings, version and cache assumptions. These are not field p95 or a change to frontend NEXUS-PERF-01.
